reason: The flippers need a pivot to move, and this is the only offered action.
expectation: I expect the blades to attach to the pivot plate, though I don't yet know how they'll be operated.

effect: The flippers are button-operated and return using a soft loop; they can now be fitted to the table.
reaction: The short button moving a longer paddle is a satisfying mechanism.
reason: Fitting the flippers to the table is the only offered combination and advances the game.
expectation: I expect the flippers to attach to the marble table so they can send the marble back into play.

effect: The flippers are now fitted to the table; adding targets is the next offered combination.
reason: The target arches are the only offered combination and should give the player something to aim for.
expectation: I expect the arches to attach to the table as targets, though I don't know how scoring will work yet.

effect: The table now has three targets and is ready for a marble test.
reaction: The targets make the game feel more purposeful, though fitting them was straightforward.
reason: The marble is the only offered combination and should let me test the table.
expectation: I expect the marble to roll through the game and reveal how the targets work, though scoring may still need another part.

effect: The gentle launch reaches the lower arches, but the top arch may need a longer launch using the adjustable stop.
reaction: Testing revealed a concrete reason to adjust the launcher.
reason: The screwdriver is the only offered combination and should adjust the stop for the top arch.
expectation: I expect to adjust the launcher for a longer shot, though I don't know whether that will reach the top arch.

effect: The stop now permits more spring compression while keeping the launch gentle; the longer setting is ready to test.
reaction: The explanation makes the adjustment clear.
reason: Testing the marble is the only offered combination and should show whether the longer launch reaches the top arch.
expectation: I expect the marble to launch farther, possibly reaching the top arch.

effect: The longer launch reaches the top arch, and the flippers can send the returning marble through another target.
reaction: Seeing the adjustment pay off across all three arches is satisfying.
reason: The score wheel is the only offered combination and should add a way to keep score.
expectation: I expect the score wheel to be fitted to the table, though I don't know how it will advance.

effect: The score wheel is turned by hand for each arch, and the finished table is ready for the fair.
reaction: Jo's bonus-target joke and the queue of one give the finished game a pleasant ending.

mostWorthwhile.text: Testing the longer launch was most worthwhile: it showed the adjustment reaching the top arch and the flippers sending the marble through another.

leastWorthwhile.text: Fitting the flippers and targets was straightforward but less engaging than testing the mechanism.

surprise.text: The adjustable stop let the spring compress farther while keeping the plunger enclosed and the push gentle.

arbitrary.text: No action felt purposeless, though the early fittings offered no meaningful choice because each was the only combination available.

continue.text: I would continue: the test-and-adjust sequence made the mechanism understandable, and I am curious what the fair will do next.
